16impl GameEnv {
17    pub(in crate::env) fn resolve_effect_payload(
18        &mut self,
19        controller: u8,
20        source_id: CardId,
21        payload: &EffectPayload,
22    ) {
23        match &payload.spec.kind {
24            EffectKind::Draw { count } => {
25                self.draw_to_hand(controller, *count as usize);
26            }
27            EffectKind::Brainstorm {
28                reveal_count,
29                per_climax,
30                mode,
31            } => {
32                brainstorm::brainstorm(
33                    self,
34                    controller,
35                    source_id,
36                    payload,
37                    *reveal_count,
38                    *per_climax,
39                    *mode,
40                );
41            }
42            EffectKind::BrainstormDrawChoice => {
43                brainstorm::brainstorm_draw_choice(self, controller);
44            }
45            EffectKind::RandomDiscardFromHand { target, count } => {
46                random::random_discard_from_hand(self, controller, *target, *count);
47            }
48            EffectKind::RandomMill { target, count } => {
49                random::random_mill(self, controller, *target, *count);
50            }
51            EffectKind::RevealDeckTop { count, audience } => {
52                reveal::reveal_deck_top(self, controller, *count, *audience);
53            }
54            EffectKind::RevealZoneTop {
55                target,
56                zone,
57                count,
58                audience,
59            } => {
60                reveal::reveal_zone_top(self, controller, *target, *zone, *count, *audience);
61            }
62            EffectKind::RevealTopIfLevelAtLeastMoveThisToHand { min_level } => {
63                reveal::reveal_top_if_level_at_least_move_this_to_hand(
64                    self, controller, payload, *min_level,
65                );
66            }
67            EffectKind::RevealTopIfLevelAtLeastRestThis { min_level } => {
68                reveal::reveal_top_if_level_at_least_rest_this(
69                    self, controller, payload, *min_level,
70                );
71            }
72            EffectKind::RevealTopIfLevelAtLeastMoveTopToStock { min_level } => {
73                reveal::reveal_top_if_level_at_least_move_top_to_stock(
74                    self, controller, *min_level,
75                );
76            }
77            EffectKind::LookTopDeckReorder { count: _ } => {
78                look_search::look_top_deck_reorder(self, controller, payload);
79            }
80            EffectKind::LookTopCardTopOrWaitingRoom => {
81                look_search::look_top_card_top_or_waiting_room(self, payload);
82            }
83            EffectKind::LookTopCardTopOrBottom => {
84                look_search::look_top_card_top_or_bottom(self, payload);
85            }
86            EffectKind::SearchTopDeckToHandLevelAtLeastMillRest {
87                look_count,
88                choose_count,
89                min_level,
90            } => {
91                look_search::search_top_deck_to_hand_level_at_least_mill_rest(
92                    self,
93                    controller,
94                    *look_count,
95                    *choose_count,
96                    *min_level,
97                );
98            }
99            EffectKind::RevealTopAndSalvageByRevealedLevel {
100                count,
101                climax_level,
102            } => {
103                look_search::reveal_top_and_salvage_by_revealed_level(
104                    self,
105                    controller,
106                    *count,
107                    *climax_level,
108                );
109            }
110            EffectKind::Damage {
111                amount,
112                cancelable,
113                damage_type: _,
114            } => {
115                damage::damage(self, controller, source_id, payload, *amount, *cancelable);
116            }
117            EffectKind::AddModifier {
118                kind,
119                magnitude,
120                duration,
121            } => {
122                modifiers::add_modifier(self, source_id, payload, *kind, *magnitude, *duration);
123            }
124            EffectKind::GrantAbilityDef { ability, duration } => {
125                modifiers::grant_ability_def(self, controller, payload, ability, *duration);
126            }
127            EffectKind::AddPowerIfTargetLevelAtLeast {
128                amount,
129                min_level,
130                duration,
131            } => {
132                modifiers::add_power_if_target_level_at_least(
133                    self, source_id, payload, *amount, *min_level, *duration,
134                );
135            }
136            EffectKind::AddPowerByTargetLevel {
137                multiplier,
138                duration,
139            } => {
140                modifiers::add_power_by_target_level(
141                    self,
142                    source_id,
143                    payload,
144                    *multiplier,
145                    *duration,
146                );
147            }
148            EffectKind::AddPowerIfBattleOpponentLevelAtLeast {
149                amount,
150                min_level,
151                duration,
152            } => {
153                modifiers::add_power_if_battle_opponent_level_at_least(
154                    self, source_id, payload, *amount, *min_level, *duration,
155                );
156            }
157            EffectKind::AddSoulIfBattleOpponentLevelAtLeast {
158                amount,
159                min_level,
160                duration,
161            } => {
162                modifiers::add_soul_if_battle_opponent_level_at_least(
163                    self, source_id, payload, *amount, *min_level, *duration,
164                );
165            }
166            EffectKind::AddPowerIfBattleOpponentLevelExact {
167                amount,
168                level,
169                duration,
170            } => {
171                modifiers::add_power_if_battle_opponent_level_exact(
172                    self, source_id, payload, *amount, *level, *duration,
173                );
174            }
175            EffectKind::AddPowerIfOtherAttackerMatches {
176                amount,
177                duration,
178                attacker_card_ids,
179            } => {
180                modifiers::add_power_if_other_attacker_matches(
181                    self,
182                    source_id,
183                    payload,
184                    *amount,
185                    *duration,
186                    attacker_card_ids,
187                );
188            }
189            EffectKind::AddSoulIfMiddleCenter { amount } => {
190                modifiers::add_soul_if_middle_center(self, source_id, payload, *amount);
191            }
192            EffectKind::FacingOpponentAddSoul { amount } => {
193                modifiers::facing_opponent_add_soul(self, source_id, payload, *amount);
194            }
195            EffectKind::FacingOpponentAddModifier {
196                kind,
197                magnitude,
198                duration,
199            } => {
200                modifiers::facing_opponent_add_modifier(
201                    self, source_id, payload, *kind, *magnitude, *duration,
202                );
203            }
204            EffectKind::SelfAddModifierIfFacingOpponent {
205                kind,
206                magnitude,
207                duration,
208                max_level,
209                max_cost,
210                level_gt_source_level,
211            } => {
212                modifiers::self_add_modifier_if_facing_opponent(
213                    self,
214                    source_id,
215                    payload,
216                    *kind,
217                    *magnitude,
218                    *duration,
219                    *max_level,
220                    *max_cost,
221                    *level_gt_source_level,
222                );
223            }
224            EffectKind::ConditionalAddModifier {
225                kind,
226                magnitude,
227                duration,
228                turn,
229                zone_count,
230                require_source_marker,
231                per_source_marker,
232                per_zone_count,
233                exclude_source,
234            } => {
235                modifiers::conditional_add_modifier(
236                    self,
237                    controller,
238                    source_id,
239                    payload,
240                    *kind,
241                    *magnitude,
242                    *duration,
243                    *turn,
244                    zone_count.as_ref(),
245                    *require_source_marker,
246                    *per_source_marker,
247                    *per_zone_count,
248                    *exclude_source,
249                );
250            }
251            EffectKind::MoveToHand => {
252                movement::move_to_hand(self, payload);
253            }
254            EffectKind::MoveToWaitingRoom => {
255                movement::move_to_waiting_room(self, payload);
256            }
257            EffectKind::MoveToStock => {
258                movement::move_to_stock(self, payload);
259            }
260            EffectKind::MoveToClock => {
261                movement::move_to_clock(self, payload);
262            }
263            EffectKind::MoveToMemory => {
264                movement::move_to_memory(self, payload);
265            }
266            EffectKind::MoveToDeckBottom => {
267                movement::move_to_deck_bottom(self, payload);
268            }
269            EffectKind::MoveWaitingRoomCardToSourceSlot => {
270                movement::move_waiting_room_card_to_source_slot(self, payload);
271            }
272            EffectKind::RecycleWaitingRoomToDeckShuffle => {
273                movement::recycle_waiting_room_to_deck_shuffle(self, controller);
274            }
275            EffectKind::ResetStockFromDeckTop { target } => {
276                movement::reset_stock_from_deck_top(self, controller, *target);
277            }
278            EffectKind::MoveToMarker => {
279                movement::move_to_marker(self, payload);
280            }
281            EffectKind::MoveTopDeckToMarker => {
282                movement::move_top_deck_to_marker(self, payload);
283            }
284            EffectKind::Heal => {
285                healing::heal(self, payload);
286            }
287            EffectKind::HealIfSourcePlayedFromHandThisTurn => {
288                healing::heal_if_source_played_from_hand_this_turn(self, payload);
289            }
290            EffectKind::MoveTriggerCardToHand => {
291                trigger::move_trigger_card_to_hand(self, controller, source_id);
292            }
293            EffectKind::MoveTriggerCardToStock => {
294                trigger::move_trigger_card_to_stock(self, controller);
295            }
296            EffectKind::MillTop { target, count } => {
297                movement::mill_top(self, controller, *target, *count);
298            }
299            EffectKind::MoveStageSlot { slot } => {
300                movement::move_stage_slot(self, payload, *slot);
301            }
302            EffectKind::MoveThisToOpenCenter { require_facing } => {
303                movement::move_this_to_open_center(self, payload, *require_facing);
304            }
305            EffectKind::MoveThisToOpenBack => {
306                movement::move_this_to_open_back(self, payload);
307            }
308            EffectKind::SwapStageSlots => {
309                movement::swap_stage_slots(self, payload);
310            }
311            EffectKind::ChangeController { new_controller } => {
312                movement::change_controller(self, controller, payload, *new_controller);
313            }
314            EffectKind::Standby { target_slot } => {
315                trigger::standby(self, controller, payload, *target_slot);
316            }
317            EffectKind::TreasureStock { take_stock } => {
318                trigger::treasure_stock(self, controller, *take_stock);
319            }
320            EffectKind::ModifyPendingAttackDamage { delta } => {
321                damage::modify_pending_attack_damage(self, *delta);
322            }
323            EffectKind::EnableShotDamage { amount } => {
324                damage::enable_shot_damage(self, *amount);
325            }
326            EffectKind::SetTriggerCheckCount { count } => {
327                trigger::set_trigger_check_count(self, *count);
328            }
329            EffectKind::RestThisIfNoOtherRestCenter => {
330                movement::rest_this_if_no_other_rest_center(self, payload);
331            }
332            EffectKind::RestTarget => {
333                movement::rest_target(self, payload);
334            }
335            EffectKind::StandTarget => {
336                movement::stand_target(self, payload);
337            }
338            EffectKind::StockCharge { count } => {
339                movement::stock_charge(self, controller, *count);
340            }
341            EffectKind::CannotUseAutoEncoreForPlayer { target } => {
342                modifiers::cannot_use_auto_encore_for_player(self, controller, *target);
343            }
344            EffectKind::TriggerIcon { icon } => {
345                trigger::trigger_icon(self, controller, source_id, payload, *icon);
346            }
347            EffectKind::BattleOpponentReverseIf {
348                max_level,
349                max_cost,
350                level_gt_opponent_level,
351            } => {
352                battle::battle_opponent_reverse_if(
353                    self,

355                    *max_level,
356                    *max_cost,
357                    *level_gt_opponent_level,
358                );
359            }
360            EffectKind::BattleOpponentMoveToDeckBottomIf {
361                max_level,
362                max_cost,
363                level_gt_opponent_level,
364            } => {
365                battle::battle_opponent_move_to_deck_bottom_if(
366                    self,
367                    payload,
368                    *max_level,
369                    *max_cost,
370                    *level_gt_opponent_level,
371                );
372            }
373            EffectKind::BattleOpponentMoveToStockThenBottomStockToWaitingRoomIf {
374                max_level,
375                max_cost,
376                level_gt_opponent_level,
377            } => {
378                battle::battle_opponent_move_to_stock_then_bottom_stock_to_waiting_room_if(
379                    self,
380                    payload,
381                    *max_level,
382                    *max_cost,
383                    *level_gt_opponent_level,
384                );
385            }
386            EffectKind::BattleOpponentMoveToClockAfterClockTopToWaitingRoomIf {
387                max_level,
388                max_cost,
389                level_gt_opponent_level,
390            } => {
391                battle::battle_opponent_move_to_clock_after_clock_top_to_waiting_room_if(
392                    self,
393                    payload,
394                    *max_level,
395                    *max_cost,
396                    *level_gt_opponent_level,
397                );
398            }
399            EffectKind::BattleOpponentMoveToMemoryIf {
400                max_level,
401                max_cost,
402                level_gt_opponent_level,
403            } => {
404                battle::battle_opponent_move_to_memory_if(
405                    self,
406                    payload,
407                    *max_level,
408                    *max_cost,
409                    *level_gt_opponent_level,
410                );
411            }
412            EffectKind::BattleOpponentMoveToClockIf {
413                max_level,
414                max_cost,
415                level_gt_opponent_level,
416            } => {
417                battle::battle_opponent_move_to_clock_if(
418                    self,
419                    payload,
420                    *max_level,
421                    *max_cost,
422                    *level_gt_opponent_level,
423                );
424            }
425            EffectKind::BattleOpponentMove {
426                destination,
427                prelude,

429                max_cost,
430                level_gt_opponent_level,
431            } => {
432                battle::battle_opponent_move(

436                    *prelude,

441            }
442            EffectKind::BattleOpponentTopDeckToStockIf { min_level } => {
443                battle::battle_opponent_top_deck_to_stock_if(self, controller, payload, *min_level);
444            }
445            EffectKind::CounterBackup { power } => {

447            }
448            EffectKind::CounterDamageReduce { amount } => {

450            }
451            EffectKind::CounterDamageCancel => {

461    }
